# Sound Capsule

> Sound Capsule turns a public Last.fm profile into a shareable 9:16 listening
> capsule with the user's top artists, top tracks and estimated listening time.
> The image is rendered in the browser and exported as a 1080×1920 PNG.

- Canonical: https://sound-capsule-lastfm.vercel.app
- Languages: pt-BR, en, es, fr, de, it, ja, ko, zh-CN, ru, pl
- Stack: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, next-intl, html-to-image
- Deployment: Vercel, serverless and stateless
- No login, no database, no stored scrobble data

## What it does

1. Accepts a Last.fm username or profile URL.
2. Lets the user pick a recent period (last week, current month or a custom
   range of up to three calendar months).
3. Fetches public scrobbles through the Last.fm API and aggregates the top
   artists, top tracks and estimated minutes.
4. Resolves artist images from Deezer, with a client-side upload and a canvas
   fallback as alternatives.
5. Renders a customizable card (five fixed accent themes) and exports it as a
   PNG or a self-contained HTML embed snippet.

## Data sources and attribution

- Last.fm public API: user info, recent tracks and track metadata.
  See https://www.last.fm/api.
- Deezer public API for artist images.
- The site is non-commercial, is not affiliated with Last.fm and shows
  "powered by Last.fm", "Data from Last.fm" and the profile attribution.

## Privacy

Only the selected language (cookie `NEXT_LOCALE`) and the card accent theme
(localStorage `sound-capsule:theme`) are persisted. Username, date range,
results and an uploaded photo stay in memory only and are lost on reload.
Uploaded photos never leave the browser.

## Crawling

- robots.txt: https://sound-capsule-lastfm.vercel.app/robots.txt
- sitemap: https://sound-capsule-lastfm.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- API routes under /api/ are intended for the site itself and are disallowed
  to crawlers.
